product_constraint: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode, exact target full logits/state/output, configured maxima2/3, joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.
mechanism: Reuse native vendored Marlin BF16xNVFP4 M1 executor for private draft full vocabulary. Original NVFP4 checkpoint weights/block/tensor scales; startup-only packed sidecars, fixed M8 N128 K128 tile, original complete argmax and confidence consumer. No shortlist or omitted vocabulary.
numerical_boundary: Extends the existing private BF16 draft matrix arithmetic class to its shared vocabulary projection. Draft reduction may differ from scalar; this is not claimed bitwise draft-logit equivalence. Target verification/commit arithmetic remains byte-exact. Predeclare independent FP64 full-vocabulary relative L2<=0.02 on nine fixed captured draft hidden rows; compare full scalar head separately and report argmax differences. Any failed bound rejects, no widening. Complete transaction and API output gates remain mandatory.

downward_budget.scope: Head family alone cannot prove the full target; whole API selects retained value.

memory.pre_device_resource_correction: Marlin global_reduce_fp32 indexes padded M16 fragments even with M8 execution: 16 resident slots *16*128*4=131072 bytes. Corrected before first GPU enqueue; not a kernel parameter variant.

reference: Existing pinned Apache-2.0 Marlin implementation and native format preparation; no new dependency or source import. Unlike removed exact M1 paired decoder transfer, this is packed tensor-core execution and a separately qualified private draft numerical identity.

scale_audit.finding: All block scale codes69..126. With factor1 the existing scale transform has no low-scale deletion or half overflow on this pinned payload. This is format feasibility, not a numerical or speed pass.

gates: Nine complete independent FP64 vocabulary vectors plus scalar-head comparison, using authenticated P513 draft hidden captures at rows0,1,2,16,32,64,128,256,511.
Full P65 scalar-target state/logit/cache transactions then immediate d2 P65/8K/40K API; >3% slowdown or nonpositive 8K stops. Useful long direction unlocks d3.
expiry: Mandatory next full API return or rejection; no uncomposed performance retention.
